_about: Data-driven model catalog + device profiles for pigemma (docs/design/manifest.json files[] 'pigemma/data/catalog.json' and data_formats 'catalog.json'). Consumers: pigemma.feasibility.load_catalog, pigemma.cache_sim --catalog, pi/04_fetch_model.sh, pigemma.gguf_map catalog-refresh, README/docs.

Provenance rule: every number carries a source string that starts with a kind from source_kinds. Plain numeric fields are sourced in the sibling 'sources' object (keyed by field name); {value, source} objects and dicts with a 'source' key carry their own. Any number that was not measured has a source containing the word 'assumed'.

Models: kind 'moe' | 'dense' are runnable targets; kind 'draft' entries are speculative-decoding sidecars (draft_of, spec_type for --spec-type) and are never verdict rows. local_path is repo-relative (matches pigemma/paths.py MODELS) or null when the file is not on the desktop. Download URL: https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<main|revision>/<file>; verify bytes and sha256 after download.

Per-token budgets: nonexpert_bytes_per_token is read on every decoded token; expert_bytes_per_token_worst is the expert traffic with nothing cached (= n_moe_layers x n_expert_used x expert_unit_bytes for uniform quants; 802,897,920 B for 26b-q4). Prefer expert_bytes_per_token_worst over a hard-coded constant: the UD quants vary the expert quant type per layer, so their expert_unit_bytes is a mean (exact range in _min/_max).

Deviation from the manifest spec (2026-10-05): the unsloth alternatives were specified as bytes_exact:false placeholders ('<fill from HF listing>') with a Q4_0-ratio split flagged estimated:true. They were filled instead from a live read-only HfApi.model_info(files_metadata=True) listing (exact file names, sizes, LFS sha256, revision) and from HTTP Range reads of each GGUF header (exact non-expert/expert split), so bytes_exact:true and estimated:false. The Q4_0-ratio scaling would have underestimated non-expert bytes by 0.6-1.1 GB on the 26B UD quants (they keep attention/embeddings at Q4_K..Q8_0). pigemma.gguf_map catalog-refresh still fills any entry with bytes_exact:false or a placeholder file name.

Devices: the four Pi profiles and the desktop are the reference profiles for cache_sim --profiles and the docs. storage_classes holds per-storage defaults (incl. 'unknown' = conservative microSD numbers for containers and overlay roots) for any other RAM x storage combination; storage_type_default_class maps a detected type to a class. feasibility.load_catalog(io_mem=...) overwrites storage.* and mem_bw_gbps of the matching device with measured values and sets their source to 'measured'.

sources.stream_hit_rate_curve_assumed: assumed: literature prior; x = fraction of all expert-layers resident in the cache, y = LRU hit rate (SeqMoE average over 4 MoE models, docs/research/RESEARCH_SUMMARY.md sect. 3); outside the range interpolate linearly to (0, 0) below x=0.15 and hold 0.88 above x=0.45 (conservative); replaced by results/h1/sim.json (source 'simulated') when present
